title: Gaussian quadrant probability bounds
statement: Fix a correlation parameter $\rho\in(0,1)$. For all sufficiently small $\mu\in(0,1)$, the probability that two standard Gaussian coordinates with correlation $\rho$ both exceed the standard Gaussian upper-tail quantile at mass $\mu$ lies between $C_\rho\,\mu^{2/(1+\rho)}z_\mu^{2-2/(1+\rho)}$ and $\mu^{2/(1+\rho)}$, where $z_\mu$ is that quantile and $C_\rho$ is the stated positive constant depending on $\rho$.
